items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Yeah, Clay Giles. He played with me.

ctx.x: Did any of your uncles ever play in that?
Yeah, Clay Giles. He played with me.
I saw a picture of them. And it's supposed to be him in the picture. Have you ever seen that picture? It's in the book Jazz Man?

items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Well my uncles, Clay Giles, Oscar Giles, Olivier Giles, where I know of them were playing in brass band was in Yardins.

ctx.x: All five? That's right. What were their names? I remember the name Clay Giles.
Clay Giles. Oscar Giles. Olivier Giles. And Major Giles. And Albert Giles.
Every one were drummers? All of them was drummers. They all live up in Thibodeau?
